parsed.reason: Multiple critical failures against the rubric: points at a website/settings page (villagehale.com/settings); includes pressure and a deadline (24 hours); uses a greeting ("Hi there!"); includes an exclamation mark and hype; doesn't ask for the address in a plain way - instead directs to a settings page; explains the benefit ("Want invites?") rather than stating what they'll get; more than two clauses. This is a high-pressure sales-style message, not the quiet, plain, first-person request specified. The reference shows the correct approach: direct ask without pressure, no greeting, no app/website reference, no deadline.
